## UX quality

- [ ] Responsive layouts checked at relevant phone, tablet, and desktop sizes.
- [ ] Accessibility checks pass and keyboard/focus behavior was reviewed.
- [ ] New or changed user flows are documented in `docs/testing/USER_FLOWS.md`.
- [ ] Tests in `tests/ux/` cover changed pages/components/flows.
- [ ] Visual snapshot changes were reviewed intentionally (not auto-accepted).
